text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Yamanin Zephyr surpassed the "Emperor of the Mile," proving that the free wind can be bound by nothing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the 'first three years'—a major milestone—
passed in the best possible way.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while still basking in the afterglow
of that major milestone—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Ah... What a pleasant breeze...
How do you find it, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today, led by Yamanin Zephyr, I had come for a walk
in the woods near her birthplace—
choice_data_list: Yeah, it's a really nice breeze.
Yeah, it's a really nice breeze.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer, it's Tokitsukaze.
Look, it's Okuchi-san.
choice_data_list: You're right. That's a cute oriental greenfinch.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
They leave on a journey come spring,
so I'm glad we could see them. That was Isechi.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The Oriental greenfinch is a wild bird characterized by its large beak. While not particularly rare, you often won't notice them unless you're looking.
choice_data_list: That's the best part of exploring... Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Before I knew it, Yamanin Zephyr
had vanished.
choice_data_list: Um, which way would Zephyr go...?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.
choice_data_list: I knew you'd be over here.
I had a feeling you'd be over here.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer-san...
Where have you been? Chasing after willow catkins?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She was the one who wandered off somewhere...
though it would be tactless to point that out.
choice_data_list: Yeah. Just wandering around a bit.
Yeah. Just wandering around a bit.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: That was an auspicious breeze, wasn't it? Did it make a gentle rustling sound?
choice_data_list: Yeah. That was a nice wind.
Yeah. That was a nice breeze.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Wonderful.
Say, Trainer, shall we enjoy the breeze?
choice_data_list: Wanna relax? How about we head by the riverbank then?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh...? Um, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: It's a strange feeling somehow.
choice_data_list: What's wrong?
What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Um... It seems I'm just a little out of sync with everyone else.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Even when I'm speaking, the conversation often stalls, or people ask me to repeat myself.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Also, even though I was walking with someone,
before I knew it, I'd end up all alone...
choice_data_list: (Well, I suppose that's true...)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I figured that was just how things were
and never paid it any mind, but—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
When I'm with you, Trainer,
even if that's the case... how should I put it?
It doesn't really bother me.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...It's strange.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Well, after spending three years together, you kind of get used to it... or rather, you can pretty much predict what'll happen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: To put it in her own words—
choice_data_list: Does that mean it's become a weathervane?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Like a weathervane...?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: No, could it be...?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"...I see.
So you too have become a true wind, Trainer."
choice_data_list: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...Deep down, I suppose part of me always felt
that wanting to 'become the wind'
was nothing more than an absurd fantasy.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Even with someone like me, once I started getting results in the racing world, people began telling me, "Your running is like the wind itself."
choice_data_list: That's the result of your hard work.
This is the result of your hard work.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
That may be true. But... haven't I been
carried by the wind this entire time?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Carried by the favorable tailwind that is my Trainer, I was able to soar to places I never could have imagined—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"Perhaps I was just a leaf
dancing in the wind like that."
choice_data_list: That's not true.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Even if I had the kind of power she spoke of, it was she herself who achieved the results."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: So, if I had to say—
choice_data_list: The two of us became the wind.
The two of us became the wind together!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, I see.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"The wind is inherently free.
That is precisely why... we can also blow together in succession."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Fufufufu.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: It was as if winds of fortune, auspicious breezes, refreshing gales, and triumphant gusts had all blown in at once—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer, won't you
stay here with me a little longer?"

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Let us bathe in the breeze here.
...Just a little longer.
